name: defense-shape
description: Subtractive (shipped) vs divisive mitigation, and what pierceScale is worth under each. Research: WoW scales its armour constant with attacker level, PoE with the incoming hit; both avoid a fixed divisor.

variants.name: v3-divisive-k0.5
variants.note: defense = half offense halves the hit

variants.name: v5-divisive-k2
variants.note: defense must be 2x offense to halve
